A dying warrior broke his own gold tooth to give it away. Stay till the end, who he gave it to will surprise you.
As the story goes, Karna never said no to anyone who asked. On the last day of the war, he lay dying on the battlefield. But an old brahmin came, and asked him for gold.
Karna had nothing left. So he broke his own gold tooth with a stone, and offered it with a smile. Wait, who was the brahmin?
It was Krishna, and He blessed Karna forever. That's why we call Karna Daanveer. Giving is greatest when it costs you something. Comment Karna, and send this to the most generous person you know.
